title: Learn the first pair of base orders on physically observed Master6 opening turns
training: All 218 previously signed train maps exactly once per epoch, one real physical-seat t0 with all legal base slots. Balanced by map and inverse square-root train-set base role frequency within each map. No early-turn proxies, no terminal rewards or future state.
model: One shared additive FP32 linear layer mapping the active Sapling decoder hidden state at a base slot to three raw Sapling scores, zero initialization. Active only during public step zero, normal 75/25 mixing afterwards. No seat, seed, map identifier, base UID, fixed composition or slot-specific weights.
training_stop: Stop if all demonstration-prefix training base predictions are correct and CE is below 0.04 for five consecutive updates, nonfinite is an error. Final step is used, no checkpoint choice or tuning on val/holdout.
comparators: Exact original active 85c47d5d, older original composite c5ad3f43, same-budget standalone control 96999753, and most common exact ordered base-command pair in training (diagnostic only). Report both base-order orientations, only actual economic comp selection signals are observational.
validation: All historical 10 val and 18 holdout, and 18 earlier-exposed losses separately. Fixed 12 step normal-entry calendar from preceding probe. All off-window policies must agree with the active composite on the same given history, even when the real opening command differs. No new original games from this code.
